segments.text: When your dental front desk is busy or closed, an appointment enquiry can end before anyone helps.

visual.headline: Give them a clear next step.
visual.note: Use your own call records: enquiries → bookings → attendance

segments.text: FlowAudit builds AI phone agents that support your team through agreed workflows. The separate recording below shows an enquiry, available times and a Google Calendar booking, with privacy beeps and edited labels. It's demonstration evidence, not customer results.

visual.headline: Support for your team.
visual.note: Watch the separate booking recording on this page · Demonstration, not customer results

segments.text: Published US exam, cleaning and X-ray costs range from fifty to three hundred fifty dollars. That's a fee benchmark, not a revenue forecast. Use your own attendance, collections and costs. Missed calls aren't automatically lost patients.

visual.headline: Use your own figures.
visual.note: Actual value depends on attendance, treatment and collections, before costs

segments.text: Your scheduling system, appointment types and forwarding need checking. Compatibility, patient-data and security requirements must be resolved before proceeding.

visual.headline: Check the fit first.
visual.note: Compatibility is assessed for your practice; every system is not promised.

segments.text: Urgent calls follow practice-approved escalation and human-handoff rules. The recorded question doesn't establish validated clinical triage or a completed emergency handoff. Clinical judgment stays with your team.

visual.headline: Your team approves the rules.
visual.note: Question excerpt in the detailed walkthrough: not validated triage or a completed emergency handoff

segments.text: Agree scope and investment first. Agreement and initial payment start configuration, followed by testing with your team. Practice approval comes before activation.

visual.headline: Agree. Configure. Test. Approve.
visual.note: Confirm deliverable scope, requirements and investment before proceeding

segments.text: Book a fifteen-minute demo and fit assessment. Bring your purchasing decision-maker. Groups should include relevant approvers. We'll discuss requirements, investment and the next decision.

visual.headline: Book a 15-minute demo & fit assessment.
visual.note: Requirements · Scope · Implementation · Investment · The next decision
